unit.why: A single narrative about the tzaddik's sexual abstinence, his mother's complaint to R. Moshe of Sambor, the decree to resume marital relations, and the birth and early death of a holy son.

stories.start_quote: ידעתי נאמנה מפי גאון וצדיק אחד
stories.summary_en: In his great devekut the tzaddik stopped visiting his wife even on immersion nights. His mother complained to his uncle R. Moshe of Sambor, who decreed that he fulfil his marital duty. A holy son was born, but the child died young because of a word the tzaddik let slip on the day of the decree.
